limitations: Approved offline M1 replay; no model was called.
title: Restrict account data to its owner
intent: Users may access or change only account data they are authorized to own.
preconditions: A target account or profile belongs to a user.
A request is made by an authenticated user.

expected_behaviors.description: The owner can access their own private account data.

forbidden_behaviors.description: A non-owner cannot access another user's private account data.
A non-owner cannot change another user's private account data.

authorization_constraints: Private account access and changes are limited to the account owner.
unknowns: Administrative access and delegated ownership rules are not specified.
